description: Exchange Rates. Get current ECB exchange rates for any supported base currency. Optionally filter to specific target currencies. Updated daily from the European Central Bank. Credit cost: 1 credit per call.

base.description: Base currency ISO 4217 code (defaults to EUR). Default: "EUR".

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to keep in the response, with dot notation for nested fields (e.g. name,location.city). Does not change the credit cost.

symbols.description: Comma-separated target currency codes to filter (e.g. USD,GBP,JPY).

name: vat_rates
title: Exchange Rates
